task: Use a Workers-compatible fail-closed redirect mode for Queue billing analytics.
nonGoals: No weakening of cost admission, frontend changes, provider changes, CPU or usage limit changes, or unrelated services.

outcomes.description: Queue analytics can query billing and Queue operations on native workerd while denying redirects without following them.
outcomes.evidence: Native workerd collects account metrics from frozen loopback responses and observes one request when redirected.

process.description: Track the scoped runtime correction in a separately planned and independently reviewed PR.
process.evidence: Git plan, test record and review.

styleEfficiency.description: Use the established manual Worker redirect pattern and retain existing fail-closed checks.

exitTest.reason: The analytics transport correction leaves checkpoint and queue continuation protocols unchanged.

context: Live PR 60 submission was denied before capture because workerd does not implement Fetch redirect:error.
